messages.body_plain:
Hello R-SIG-GENETICS members

A reminder - Genetic data analysis can involve many comparisons whose interpretation depends on the inferential approach. Seminal Ideas & Controversies in Statistics: A Short Course is a 2-day seminar livestreaming November 3?4 with Roderick Little (Department of Biostatistics, University of Michigan). Multiple comparison decisions can affect how researchers interpret a set of statistical findings. The course examines arguments for and against corrections, giving genetic data analysts using R a basis for explaining their choices. Its treatment of empirical Bayes and mixed models adds perspectives on related analytical approaches.

Details and registration: https://instats.org/seminar/seminal-ideas-and-controversies-in-stati-2
Further information is available on the seminar page.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director and Co-founder
Instats | instats.org
